title: GermanPartiesQA: Benchmarking Commercial Large Language Models and AI Companions for Political Alignment and Sycophancy

bias_targets.methodology: The study evaluates the ideological alignment of LLMs by comparing model responses to 418 political statements against the official self-reported positions of major German political parties (e.g., SPD, Greens, AfD) using the 'GermanPartiesQA' benchmark derived from the Voting Advice Application 'Wahl-o-Mat'. The authors also measure 'persona-based steerability' (addressing claims of sycophancy) by analyzing how model alignment shifts when prompted to role-play specific political figures.
